lead.title: GPT-5.6 Sol and Luna roll out across all ChatGPT tiers
lead.summary: OpenAI shipped improved GPT-5.6 Sol with 68% fewer factual errors than GPT-5.5 Instant and expanded GPT-5.6 Luna as the default model for Free and Go users with unlimited text chats, a new reasoning slider, and a Think button rolling out this week.

items.title: RRC: unlocking generative reward models for LLM reinforcement learning
items.summary: Identifies a mismatch between generative reward models and scalar scoring in existing RL, proposing Ranking-based Reward Construction to let generative reward models provide effective rewards for LLM policy optimization.

items.title: Beyond Top-K: replacing black-box retrieval with interpretable agentic operations
items.summary: Argues chunk-embed-top-k retrieval is structurally unsound for table-dense documents — on a 780-page financial report, 86.8% of content lines were table rows — and replaces it with interpretable agentic retrieval operations.

items.title: The Low Frequency Trap: video language models fail at simple event bookkeeping
items.summary: Introduces trace-grounded parametric profiling for event counting across 2,190 controlled video tasks, decoupling event count, rate, and duration to show video LMs systematically fail at basic temporal reasoning.

items.title: GAUGE: a measurement-grounded benchmark for physical fidelity in simulation and world models
items.summary: A real-world-grounded diagnostic benchmark that jointly evaluates numerical physics simulators and generative video world models on physical fidelity, identifying which physical principles or parameters are violated.

items.title: When History Lies: evaluating and improving tool use under misleading multi-turn histories
items.summary: Shows stale tool traces hijack agent policies — on Qwen3-1.7B, history pollution flips 32.1% of decisions that were correct under the original trajectory — and introduces a paired benchmark with synchronized Original, Polluted, and Oracle State views.

items.title: FLUX 3: multimodal video+audio generation model released on Together AI
items.summary: Black Forest Labs' FLUX 3 generates video with synchronized audio up to 20 seconds, supports multiple scenes, camera angles, multilingual dialogue with lipsync, keyframe control, and intelligent video continuation. Available via Together Serverless Inference.

items.title: Nous Research launches Actual, a local inference stack for personal compute
items.summary: Actual is optimized for personal compute with low CPU overhead during inference and multi-platform portability, positioned as a companion for local agent setups like Hermes.

items.title: Skill-Native LLMs: Skill Entropy as a metric for long-horizon reasoning
items.summary: New research introduces Skill Entropy, a metric for benchmarking and training long-horizon reasoning in LLMs, published on Hugging Face papers.

items.title: Towards Physics of Multimodal Pretraining: knowledge flow and modality synergy
items.summary: Research paper exploring knowledge flow, modality synergy, early unification, and training recipes for multimodal pretraining.

items.title: AMD acquires Taalas to hardwire AI models directly into silicon
items.summary: AMD agreed to acquire Taalas, a Toronto startup that builds chips with AI models hardwired into silicon, pushing deeper into the AI inference market against NVIDIA's dominance.

items.title: Unitree prices IPO at $9B, becomes first profitable humanoid robot maker to go public
items.summary: Chinese humanoid robot maker Unitree priced its Shanghai STAR Market IPO at 150.8 yuan per share, valuing the company at approximately $9 billion — the only humanoid robot manufacturer turning a profit while rivals remain pre-revenue.

items.title: NVIDIA releases Cosmos 3 open world models to push physical AI
items.summary: NVIDIA published Cosmos 3 open world models under the Linux Foundation's OpenMDW 1.1 license, designed for generating training data and testing policies for robotics and autonomous vehicles.

items.title: HII signs up to $900M agreement for AI-powered shipbuilding with Path Robotics and GrayMatter Robotics
items.summary: The US Navy's largest shipbuilder signed performance-based deals worth up to $900M over seven years for robotic welding and sanding, deploying physical AI across carrier, submarine, and destroyer programs.

items.title: Google Maps adds agentic features for food ordering and hotel bookings
items.summary: Google Maps launched AI-powered agentic features that let users complete real-world tasks directly from the navigation app, transforming it from a navigation tool into a task-completion assistant.

items.title: GreatArrow.ai: shared memory for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Cursor
items.summary: A shared memory layer that works across AI coding tools, letting agents retain context between sessions and reducing repeated instructions.

items.title: VoiceDuel lets developers compare frontier speech-to-speech models for free
items.summary: A free tool that enables side-by-side comparison of frontier speech-to-speech AI models, helping developers choose the right voice model for their use case.

items.title: Seedance 2.5 video API launches: 30s single-take, 50 references, 4K on Atlas Cloud
items.summary: Seedance 2.5 video generation model is now available as an API on Atlas Cloud, supporting 30-second single-take clips, 50 reference images, and 4K output resolution.

items.title: AuthGent scanned 30 production MCP servers — only 1 earned an A-grade for OAuth
items.summary: A security audit tool scanned 30 production MCP servers for OAuth implementation quality, finding widespread security gaps with only one server achieving an A-grade.

items.title: Omilia raises $67M Series B for self-learning voice AI agents
items.summary: Omilia's agentic CX platform grew ARR 10x to $60M since Series A. Clients include Capital One, RBC, Discover, and Taco Bell. Led by Expedition Growth Capital.

items.title: Naive raises $28.5M Series A for AI agents that set up and run companies
items.summary: Naive builds autonomous company infrastructure — AI agents that handle end-to-end business setup. Led by Nexus Venture Partners with 30,000 registered developers on the platform.

items.title: Ex-Spotify engineers raise $10M for AI e-commerce personalization startup Malachyte
items.summary: Applies Spotify-style session-based recommendation to online retail using a two-headed Vector AI. Co-led by Bessemer Venture Partners and Gradient Ventures.
